title: The Shared Secret
space: the student's own namespace `students/{user}`, database `app_{user}`, fork and app slot
goal: Give a teammate's app read access to one of your secrets without giving it access to anything else in your namespace.
seed: in the student's namespace, a teammate identity `buddy-{user}` with no policy, and two secrets at `challenge/one` and `challenge/two` in a KV mount the seed creates there.
verify_text: in `students/{user}`: `policy_attached` for `buddy-{user}`, allows read of exactly one path, denied on the other.
isolation: namespace-scoped; the shared `secret/` mount is not touched.
hints: The path in the policy is the whole permission.
